additional_info.body:
Jagmeet Singh was assigned as new Case Manager for case 0480318 .
Link to Case:
https://isp.crm4.dynamics.com/main.aspx?appid=582042be-d464-ed11-9562-000d3ab780dd&pagetype=entityrecord&etn=incident&id=f4d126fb-cd19-4da4-8ce5-ddb542327e24

We have had a long ongoing problem regarding Cheap Charge Värnamo, the linked charger (asset), I don't know if you can see the previous history about the matter. It has had major problems with various error messages, mainly regarding temperature warnings. But the problem continues at the same pace and the charger sends error messages almost continuously. It sends the following error messages all the time:
Faulted: OtherError: overheat error - (DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101: overheat error)
Faulted: OtherError: overheat error|DC+=16.8°C|DC-=100.2°C - (DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101: overheat error|DC+=16.8°C|DC-=100.2°C)
Faulted: OtherError: - (Indication: Cable theft: )
Magnus Hellberg (magnus.hellberg@siemens.com) has detailed information on the matter.
